verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a documented public API supporting search/retrieve of MailItems, authenticated via API keys/x-api-key header, with additional endpoints for locations, checks, and onboarding — matching the story of programmatic access to mail data. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of actual scan download endpoints or OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s for openapi.json), and no explicit mention of a dedicated 'download scan' endpoint beyond MailItem retrieval.
